summary.text: Stephanie Grund is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 34 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An accountant, she also holds a seat on the Souhegan Cooperative School District board in Amherst.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Grund graduated from Solon High School, attended Ohio Northern University, and earned a bachelor's degree from Case Western Reserve University in 1992.
Her career experience includes working as an accountant.
Grund assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
Ballotpedia also lists her as an officeholder of the Souhegan Cooperative School District, Amherst, with a term ending in 2029.
